name: Rough Horsetail
desc: Rough Horsetail (Equisetum hyemale): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Equisetum hyemale, commonly known as rough horsetail or scouring rush, is an evergreen perennial herbaceous pteridophyte in the horsetail family Equisetaceae native to Eurasia and Greenland.
